# 1 Enoch Chapter 83 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams

---

**1** "Now, my son Methuselah — let me tell you about all the visions I have seen. I am going to recount them all to you."

**2** Before I married, I had two visions — very different from each other. The first came when I was just learning to write. The second came before I married your mother, and it was terrifying. I prayed to the Lord about both of them.

**3** I was lying down in the house of my grandfather Mahalalel when I saw in a vision that the sky caved in — it broke apart, came crashing down, and fell to the earth.

**4** When it hit the earth, I watched the ground swallow itself into a vast abyss. Mountains piled on top of mountains. Hills collapsed into hills. Great trees were torn from their roots and hurled down into the abyss.

**5** At that moment a cry burst out of me, and I screamed aloud: "The earth is destroyed!"

**6** My grandfather Mahalalel shook me awake where I lay beside him and asked, "Why are you crying like that, my son? Why are you wailing?"

**7** I told him everything I had seen. He said: "What you have seen is terrifying, my son — and it is profoundly significant. It reveals the hidden reality behind all the sin of the earth: the earth must sink into the abyss and be utterly destroyed.

**8** Now, my son, get up and pray to the Lord of glory. You are a man of faith — beg him to preserve a remnant on the earth, and not to destroy it all.

**9** Everything in this vision will come down from heaven upon the earth, and the destruction will be enormous."

**10** I got up and prayed, pleading and crying out, and I wrote down my prayer for all future generations. And I will tell you everything, my son Methuselah.

**11** When I went outside and looked at the sky — the sun rising in the east, the moon setting in the west, a handful of stars, and the whole earth just as God had always known it — I blessed the Lord of judgment and praised him for sending the sun out through the eastern windows of heaven, rising and climbing across the face of the sky and traveling the path laid out for it.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Chapter 83 opens the Book of Dreams. Enoch's first vision is a pre-flood catastrophe: the sky collapses and the earth is swallowed. Mahalalel's response is crucial — he interprets the vision correctly and counsels intercession. The chapter ends with Enoch going outside and being comforted by the ordinary beauty of sunrise — the world still functioning as God intended. This framing (cosmic disaster / ordinary morning) is theologically rich.*
